articles.abstract_en: International trade and natural resource exploitation interact in multiple ways. This paper first presents a dynamic game in which the South (S) exploits (e.g., deforests) in order to export (e.g., lumber and agricultural products). Because of negative externalities, the North might lose from trade, unless the resource has already been depleted. Anticipating this, S exploits faster. All negative results are reversed if renegotiation-proof tariffs can be contingent on the size of the remaining resource stock. Larger gains from trade, and more attractive terms of trade, can be used to slow exploitation. Combined with export subsidies, the outcome is first best. (JEL C73, D62, F11, F13, F18, Q23, Q57)
articles.abstract_cn: 国际贸易与自然资源开发以多种方式相互作用。本文首先提出了一个动态博弈，其中南方（S）为了出口（例如，木材和农产品）而进行开发（例如，砍伐森林）。由于负外部性，北方可能会因贸易而受损，除非资源已被耗尽。预见到这一点，南方会加速开发。如果可重新谈判的关税能够依赖于剩余资源存量的大小，则所有负面结果都会被逆转。更大的贸易收益和更有利的贸易条件可以用来减缓开发。结合出口补贴，结果达到最优。（JEL C73, D62, F11, F13, F18, Q23, Q57）

articles.abstract_en: Hotelling’s and Salop’s spatial competition models, as well as nested logit, covariance probit, elimination-by-aspects, and several other well-known discrete choice models, belong to the class of moderate utility models, where binary choices are a function of the ratio between utility difference and a product differentiation index satisfying the properties of a distance metric. We provide a behavioral foundation for this class of models. Our main result establishes that moderate utility has a single, directly testable implication: choice probabilities are moderately transitive. We use our characterization to show how the model achieves a useful compromise between explanatory power and predictive power. (JEL C25, D11, D91)
articles.abstract_cn: 霍特林和萨洛普的空间竞争模型，以及嵌套逻辑特、协方差概率单位、方面消除和其他几个著名的离散选择模型，都属于适度效用模型类别，其中二元选择是效用差与满足距离度量性质的产品差异化指数之比的函数。我们为这类模型提供了行为基础。我们的主要结果表明，适度效用有一个单一的、可直接检验的含义：选择概率是适度传递的。我们利用我们的特征化来展示该模型如何在解释力和预测力之间实现有用的折衷。（JEL C25, D11, D91）

articles.title_en: Debt Moratoria: Evidence from Student Loan Forbearance
articles.title_cn: 债务暂停：来自学生贷款宽限的证据
articles.abstract_en: We evaluate the effects of the 2020 student debt moratorium. Using administrative credit panel data, we compare borrowers whose loans were frozen to borrowers whose loans were not frozen based on whether the government owned the loans. We estimate that borrowers used the new liquidity to increase borrowing on mortgages, auto loans, and credit cards rather than avoid delinquencies. The effects are concentrated among borrowers without delinquencies, who saw no change in credit scores. The results highlight an important complementarity between liquidity and credit, as liquidity increases the demand for credit even as the supply of credit is fixed. (JEL E32, G21, G51, H81, I22, I23)
articles.abstract_cn: 我们评估了2020年学生债务暂停的影响。利用行政信用面板数据，我们根据政府是否拥有贷款，将贷款被冻结的借款人与贷款未被冻结的借款人进行比较。我们估计，借款人利用新的流动性增加了抵押贷款、汽车贷款和信用卡的借款，而不是避免违约。这些影响集中在没有违约的借款人中，他们的信用评分没有变化。结果凸显了流动性与信贷之间的重要互补性，因为即使在信贷供给固定的情况下，流动性也会增加对信贷的需求。(JEL E32, G21, G51, H81, I22, I23)

articles.title_en: Universalism and Political Representation: Evidence from the Field
articles.title_cn: 普世主义与政治代表：来自田野的证据
articles.abstract_en: This paper provides field evidence on the link between morals and political behavior. We create a district-level variable that reflects to what degree charitable giving decreases as a function of (geographic and social) distance, which we interpret as a real-stakes measure of citizens’ values on the universalism-particularism continuum. Our measure of district universalism is strongly predictive of local Democratic vote shares, legislators’ roll call voting, and the moral content of congressional speeches. Spatial heterogeneity in universalism is a substantially stronger predictor of geographic variation in political outcomes than traditional economic variables such as income or education. (JEL D72, D91, Z13)
articles.abstract_cn: 本文提供了关于道德与政治行为之间联系的田野证据。我们构建了一个区级变量，反映慈善捐赠随（地理和社会）距离增加而减少的程度，我们将其解释为公民在普世主义-特殊主义连续体上价值观的真实成本衡量。我们的区级普世主义指标对当地民主党选票份额、立法者唱名投票以及国会演讲的道德内容具有强烈预测性。普世主义的空间异质性对政治结果地理差异的预测能力显著强于收入或教育等传统经济变量。（JEL D72, D91, Z13）

articles.title_en: Disentangling Rent Index Differences: Data, Methods, and Scope
articles.title_cn: 解开租金指数差异：数据、方法与范围
articles.abstract_en: Rent measurement determines 32 percent of the CPI. Accurate rent measurement is therefore essential for accurate inflation measurement, but the CPI rent index often differs from alternative rent inflation measures. Using repeat-rent inflation measures created from CPI microdata, we show that this discrepancy is largely explained by differences in rent growth for new tenants relative to all tenants. New-tenant rent inflation provides information about future all-tenant rent inflation, but the use of new-tenant rents is contraindicated in a cost-of-living index such as the CPI. Nevertheless, policy-makers should integrate new-tenant inflation into inflation forecasts and monetary policy decisions. (JEL E31, E37, E52, R31)
articles.abstract_cn: 租金测量决定了CPI的32%。因此，准确的租金测量对于准确的通胀测量至关重要，但CPI租金指数往往与其他租金通胀衡量指标存在差异。利用从CPI微观数据创建的重复租金通胀指标，我们表明这种差异主要由新租户相对于所有租户的租金增长差异所解释。新租户租金通胀提供了未来所有租户租金通胀的信息，但在CPI这样的生活成本指数中使用新租户租金是不适宜的。然而，政策制定者应将新租户通胀纳入通胀预测和货币政策决策中。(JEL E31, E37, E52, R31)

articles.title_en: Inflation Expectations and Misallocation of Resources: Evidence from Italy
articles.title_cn: 通胀预期与资源错配：来自意大利的证据
articles.abstract_en: Using Italian data that include both inflation forecasts of firms and external information on their balance sheets, we study the causal effect of changes in the dispersion of beliefs about future inflation on the misallocation of resources. We find that as disagreement increases, so does misallocation. In times of low inflation, the aggregate TFP loss of the dispersed expectation-induced misallocation is moderate, but we argue that it likely becomes quite significant in times of high inflation. (JEL D22, D83, D84, E31, E37)
articles.abstract_cn: 利用包含企业通胀预测及其资产负债表外部信息的意大利数据，我们研究了未来通胀信念离散度变化对资源错配的因果效应。我们发现，随着分歧加剧，错配程度也在上升。在低通胀时期，由预期分散引发的错配所导致的总体TFP损失较为温和，但我们认为，在高通胀时期，这一损失可能变得相当显著。（JEL D22, D83, D84, E31, E37）

articles.title_en: Background Risk and Small-Stakes Risk Aversion
articles.title_cn: 背景风险与小规模风险厌恶
articles.abstract_en: Building on Pomatto, Strack, and Tamuz (2020), we identify a tight condition for when background risk can induce first-order stochastic dominance. Using this condition, we show that under plausible levels of background risk, no theory of choice under risk can simultaneously satisfy the following three economic postulates: (i) decision-makers are risk averse over small gambles, (ii) their preferences respect stochastic dominance, and (iii) they account for background risk. This impossibility result applies to expected utility theory, prospect theory, rank-dependent utility, and many other models. (JEL D81, D91)
articles.abstract_cn: 基于Pomatto、Strack和Tamuz（2020）的研究，我们确定了背景风险能够引发一阶随机占优的严格条件。利用这一条件，我们证明在合理的背景风险水平下，没有任何风险选择理论能同时满足以下三个经济假设：（i）决策者对小规模赌博是风险厌恶的，（ii）他们的偏好尊重随机占优，以及（iii）他们考虑背景风险。这一不可能性结果适用于期望效用理论、前景理论、等级依赖效用以及许多其他模型。（JEL D81, D91）

articles.title_en: The Fading Treatment Effects of a Multifaceted Asset-Transfer Program in Ethiopia
articles.title_cn: 埃塞俄比亚多层面资产转移项目治疗效应的消退
articles.abstract_en: We study the long-run effects of a big-push “graduation” program in Ethiopia in which very poor households received a one-time transfer of productive assets (mainly livestock), technical training, and access to savings accounts. After seven years, treatment effects on wealth and consumption remain economically meaningful but dissipated relative to the two- and three-year results. Treatment effects on other outcomes attenuated further. Based on absolute well-being (e.g., food security) not dropping, we argue that the treatment effect dissipation is driven primarily by improved living standards for control households rather than losses of the previously accrued benefits for the treatment households. (JEL D12, G51, I31, I32, I38, J24, O12)
articles.abstract_cn: 我们研究了埃塞俄比亚一项“大推动”式“毕业”项目的长期效应，该项目中，极贫困家庭获得了一次性生产性资产（主要是牲畜）转移、技术培训以及储蓄账户的使用权。七年后，对财富和消费的治疗效应在经济意义上仍然显著，但与两三年时的结果相比有所减弱。对其他结果变量的治疗效应进一步衰减。基于绝对福祉（如粮食安全）未下降，我们认为治疗效应的消退主要源于对照组家庭生活水平的提升，而非治疗组家庭先前所获收益的损失。（JEL D12, G51, I31, I32, I38, J24, O12）

articles.title_en: The US-China Trade War and Global Reallocations
articles.title_cn: 中美贸易战与全球再配置
articles.abstract_en: The US-China trade war created net export opportunities rather than simply shifting trade across destinations. Many “bystander” countries grew their exports of taxed products into the rest of the world (excluding the United States and China). Country-specific components of tariff elasticities, rather than specialization patterns, drove large cross-country variation in export growth of tariff-exposed products. The elasticities of exports to US-Chinese tariffs identify whether a country’s exports complement or substitute the United States or China and its supply curve’s slope. Countries that operate along downward-sloping supplies whose exports substitute (complement) the United States and China are among the larger (smaller) beneficiaries of the trade war. (JEL F13, F14, O19, P33)
articles.abstract_cn: 中美贸易战创造了净出口机会，而非仅仅在目的地之间转移贸易。许多“旁观”国家增加了对世界其他地区（不包括美国和中国）的受税产品的出口。关税弹性的国家特定组成部分，而非专业化模式，推动了受关税影响产品出口增长的跨国巨大差异。出口对中美关税的弹性识别了一个国家的出口是补充还是替代美国或中国，以及其供给曲线的斜率。那些沿着向下倾斜的供给曲线运营、其出口替代（补充）美国和中国（中国）的国家，是贸易战中较大（较小）的受益者。（JEL F13, F14, O19, P33）
